title: DualPace: Decoupled Scheduling and Cooperative GPU--CPU Decoding for LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2610.33501v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving relies on batching to improve inference throughput, but the key-value (KV) cache grows with sequence length and limits GPU-resident concurrency. CPU offloading can expand KV capacity using host memory, yet existing systems remain largely GPU-gated: CPU-resident requests make progress only when the GPU scheduler exposes suitable overlap opportunities. As a result, host memory and CPU compute cannot act as an independent serving resource, leading to bursty CPU-side progress and inflated tail inter-token latency (ITL) under load.   We present DualPace, an LLM serving runtime that turns the host into an independently scheduled decode engine. DualPace separates scheduling authority across two engines: the GPU engine executes prefills and GPU-resident decodes, while an AMX-enabled CPU engine independently batches and advances CPU-resident decodes. translated_title: DualPace：面向大语言模型服务的解耦调度与GPU-CPU协同解码
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）服务依赖批处理来提升推理吞吐量，但键值（KV）缓存会随序列长度增长，从而限制了GPU驻留的并发能力。CPU卸载技术可以利用主机内存扩展KV容量，然而现有系统在很大程度上仍受GPU制约：只有当GPU调度器暴露出合适的重叠机会时，CPU驻留的请求才能取得进展。因此，主机内存和CPU计算无法作为独立的服务资源，导致CPU端进展呈现突发性，并且在负载下尾部令牌间延迟（ITL）被显著放大。我们提出了DualPace，一个将主机转变为独立调度解码引擎的LLM服务运行时。DualPace将调度权限分离给两个引擎：GPU引擎负责执行预填充和GPU驻留解码，而启用AMX的CPU引擎则独立地对CPU驻留解码进行批处理和推进。这两个引擎在调度上是解耦的，但在执行上是协同的（原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: DualPace通过将调度权解耦给GPU引擎和AMX增强的CPU引擎，使主机内存和CPU成为独立调度的解码引擎，从而突破KV缓存对GPU并发容量的限制，并降低高负载下的尾部令牌间延迟。
en_tdlr: DualPace decouples scheduling between a GPU engine and an AMX-enabled CPU engine, turning host memory and CPU compute into an independently scheduled decode engine to expand KV capacity and reduce tail inter-token latency in LLM serving.
